name: epistemic-self-monitoring
description: Observation-vs-conjecture discipline for coding agents. Bundles the epistemic-self-monitoring skill (the 'what': claims carry their evidence and a named falsifier; only verified claims become facts or closures) with per-host hooks (the 'when'). Never holds a close by default; its opt-in strict setting holds a close once on an incomplete [EPISTEMIC CLOSE] block. Portable core: the skill only; hooks are host-specific (hooks/ for Claude Code and Codex, cursor/ for Cursor).
